title: What if we never fixed the ozone hole? ☀️
subject: ozone
description:
Would you still go outside at noon? 👇

What would happen if the ozone layer disappeared? In 2009, NASA Goddard scientists simulated a world that never banned CFCs, and it got bad fast.

Sources: NASA Goddard ("World Avoided" simulation, Newman et al., Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics, 2009), NASA Ozone Watch, British Antarctic Survey (Farman et al., Nature, 1985), UNEP/WMO Scientific Assessment of Ozone Depletion (2022)
tags: what if the ozone layer disappeared
what if there was no ozone layer

scenes.text: Without ozone, you'd sunburn in minutes at noon.
In 1985, British scientists at Halley station in Antarctica found a hole in it every spring.
The culprit was CFCs, from spray cans and fridges. In 1987, the Montreal Protocol started banning them.
In 2009, Paul Newman at NASA Goddard simulated a world that never signed it.
By 2065, two-thirds of Earth's ozone would be gone, and a second hole would open over the Arctic.
Instead, the Antarctic hole should heal around 2066.
